app.name: Pacenote
app.description: Pacenote prepares a short brief before the call, gives quiet, precise tips during it, and writes the notes after. You keep the wheel.

home.window.title: Pacenote
setup.window.title: Pacenote components
setup.subtitle: Pacenote runs speech recognition and a small AI model on this Mac. Install all puts every missing part in place, one after another, into the app folder; nothing needs an administrator password.
onboarding.window.title: Pacenote setup
onboarding.splash.footer: Audio never leaves your Mac · Pacenote {version}
onboarding.changeLater: You can change this any time in Settings
onboarding.welcome.title: Your co-driver on calls
onboarding.welcome.body: Pacenote prepares a short brief before the call, gives quiet, precise tips during it, and writes the notes after.
onboarding.welcome.row1.title: Records and transcribes on your Mac
onboarding.welcome.row1.body: Whisper runs locally; only text goes to Claude.
onboarding.welcome.row2.title: A small window next to your call
onboarding.welcome.row2.body: Facts, a ready phrase, what is on you, your speech.
onboarding.welcome.row3.title: Prepared before the call
onboarding.welcome.row3.body: A brief from your project folder in a few minutes.
onboarding.permissions.title: Let Pacenote hear your calls
onboarding.permissions.body: Your voice comes from the microphone, the other side from the call's system audio. Both are transcribed on this Mac.
onboarding.permissions.system: Capture the other side of the call
onboarding.permissions.systemNote: Turn on Pacenote under Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording.
onboarding.permissions.calendarsNote: Google and Microsoft accounts added in System Settings > Internet Accounts. Settings > Calendars later.
onboarding.folder.title: Where your projects live
onboarding.folder.body: Pacenote works with plain folders: a work folder, a folder per workspace inside it, a folder per project inside those.
onboarding.folder.empty: No workspace folders found here yet. You can add project folders later in Settings > Projects.
onboarding.projects.title: Which projects are active
onboarding.projects.body: Calls can be started only for active projects. Untick the folders that are done or not projects; you can turn them back on in Settings > Projects.
onboarding.projects.empty: No project folders found. Add them later in Settings > Projects.
onboarding.name.title: How people call you
onboarding.name.body: So Pacenote knows when a question is for you. Add the names and short forms people use on calls.
onboarding.claude.title: Connect Claude
onboarding.claude.body: Tips, answers and the call summary come from Claude with your own key, about $0.3-0.8 per call. Without a key Pacenote still records, transcribes and shows prepared facts.
onboarding.claude.saved: A key is saved; paste a new one to replace it
onboarding.install.title: Install speech recognition
onboarding.install.body: Speech recognition and a small local AI model run on this Mac (about 2.5 GB, no administrator password).
onboarding.notion.title: Connect Notion (optional)
onboarding.notion.body: After each call Pacenote adds a page to a Notion database: a short summary, decisions, action items, open questions and the transcript.
onboarding.notion.step1c: , type Internal, then copy its Internal Integration Secret (ntn_…).
onboarding.notion.step3a: In Notion open the page where meeting notes should live,
onboarding.notion.step3c: , add your integration. Pages inside it are shared too.
onboarding.notion.mirror: Control Tower user: keep a local copy of your Notion for facts and search
onboarding.done.title: Pacenote is ready
onboarding.done.body: It lives in your menu bar. During a call, press {help} when you need help.
onboarding.done.menubarHint: Look for this in the menu bar

settings.how.title: How Pacenote works
settings.about.formerly: Formerly Live Tips. Your calls, folders and permissions carry over.
settings.about.dataBody: Audio stays on this Mac. Transcripts, voice prints, settings and logs stay in your folders and the Keychain. Text goes only to the AI provider and Notion you set up, with your own keys. Nothing is sent to the author: no analytics, no tracking. Tell the people on your calls that you transcribe them and get consent where it is required.
settings.about.readyFooter: Before a call: Pacenote in the menu bar > Start a call, choose the project or workspace, Start. During the call: {help} is Help now, {pause} pauses (Settings > General > Shortcuts).
settings.calendars.note: Nothing to install: macOS keeps you signed in and syncs the calendars. Pacenote only reads them.
settings.ai.note: Pacenote builds the brief, facts and cards from local files: the project folder, the local Notion mirror, earlier calls.
notion.page.footer: Notes by Pacenote · transcribed on device
settings.calendars.blocked: A company that blocks Mail and Calendar on Macs blocks this too.
